note: Exact observation fingerprints, separate from matches. Only mass properties can be reviewed; counts, verdicts, faces, edges and vertices never. New platform observations require investigation and explicit additional records.

reviews.reason: BRepPrimAPI_MakeTorus(axes, 3, 1, pi/2, 3pi/2, 2pi) is inside out: its meridian ends lower than it starts (BRepPrim_OneAxis::isHeightInverted), and OneAxis compensates only by reversing the start and end faces of a wedge (BRepPrim_OneAxis.cxx lines 546 and 612); a full turn has none, so the shell bounds the complement. BRepCheck_Analyzer does not check solid orientation and reports it valid; BRepGProp integrates over the inverted shell. Counts, faces, edges and vertices match the reference, and the kernel builds the solid the right way out.
reviews.independent_evidence: The native volume -31.128644766134595 is the reference's 31.12864476613459 negated (Pappus: 2 pi (R 2r - pi r^2 / 2)(R - 4r/(3 pi)) = 31.1286447661346 for R = 3, r = 1), and every inertia entry is negated too, while the surface area 103.19992355679327 equals the reference's (it does not depend on orientation). The centroid, a ratio of two negated integrals, agrees.
